Scan existing physical packages into booked ocean container
Revisioned ERD/cutoff and terminal receiving eligibility
Validated export document packet and provenance

invariants: Export scanning never creates a second warehouse or physical package ledger.
Booking ID, physical ocean container ID, stock package ID, lot, sale, shipping line and forwarder remain distinct.
Earliest Return Date and Cut Off have explicit timezone, precision, terminal, voyage, source and revision; updates retain history.
Separate cargo cutoff, VGM cutoff, shipping instruction cutoff, document cutoff, and applicable customs deadline.
Physical scanned weight is not in itself certified VGM and does not control financial settlement.
No fabricated ocean B/L, gate-in, regulatory clearance, shipment, delivery or payment from scanned material or expected schedules.
